context: A mom and grandma share an old love-story memory
purpose: Teach: 告白/なぜか/何だか/あう/いまだに/貰っ/現に/伴っ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さん、お父さんからの告白って、どんな感じだったの？
lines.en: Mom, what was Dad's confession of love like?
lines.style: Curious daughter asking her mother about an old romantic memory with warmth.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ふふ、いまだに鮮明に覚えているわよ。桜の木の下でね。
lines.en: Hehe, I still remember it vividly. Under the cherry tree.
lines.style: Soft nostalgic grandmother voice, smiling as she recalls a cherished memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: えっ、何だかドラマみたいでロマンチックね。
lines.en: Oh, somehow that sounds romantic, like a drama.
lines.style: Surprised and delighted daughter, leaning in with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 彼ね、なぜか急に手紙を差し出して、緊張の伴った震える声で読み始めたの。
lines.en: He suddenly held out a letter and started reading in a trembling, nervous voice.
lines.style: Gentle grandmother narrating with tender amusement at her husband's youthful nerves.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 手紙！それでお母さん、目があう瞬間にどう答えたの？
lines.en: A letter! So how did you respond at the moment your eyes met?
lines.style: Excited daughter pressing for more details of the romantic moment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 頷くだけで精一杯。後で貰った押し花は、現に今もこの引き出しにあるのよ。
lines.en: I could only nod. The pressed flower I received is actually still in this drawer today.
lines.style: Sentimental grandmother speaking softly with deep emotional warmth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そんな宝物があったなんて知らなかった。素敵な思い出ね。
lines.en: I didn't know you had such a treasure. What a lovely memory.
lines.style: Touched daughter speaking with admiration and quiet emotion.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あなたもいつかね。本物の愛は時間を超えて続くものよ。
lines.en: Someday you'll have one too. True love lasts beyond time.
lines.style: Wise grandmother offering gentle motherly advice with affection.
